{{Quote|Where's Lab Boy?''"<br />"''Getting final preparations done on the new scapedroid. He's obliged a mobile waste droid to be fitted with a comm-equipped projector, bought in this very market, atop it. I helped him subvert the droid. Poor boy’s helpless with electronics.|Voort saBinring and Mulus Cheems|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Waste droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|automatons]] used to collect waste on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. A waste droid stood chest-high and could accommodate quite a lot of waste.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Viull Gorsat]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], subverted a waste droid with help of his adopted [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Mulus Cheems]], in order to replace a [[scapedroid]] that they had lost for a [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]]. Gorsat installed a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] on top of the droid along with an auxiliary pack.<ref name="MK" />
